notes: The site shows a Register button for the June 27 to July 2, 2027 session, but the page does not say whether registration is open. Confirm the status and cost with the program before applying.
name: Washington Youth Summit on the Environment (WYSE)
org: George Mason University with the Smithsonian's National Zoo and Conservation Biology Institute
what_you_do: A week-long program where you live on campus. You visit sites, hear talks and learn by doing with leaders in the environment, experts in conservation and researchers. Students live in GMU dorms and can earn general science credit.
who_can_apply: Highly engaged high school students. GMU's camps list says rising 11th and 12th graders. Students can register or be nominated.
pay_detail: Cost not stated on the pages read. Ask the program: 703-993-5010.
deadline_text: 2027 dates are listed (June 27 to July 2, 2027). No application deadline or cost is posted on the pages read.
how_to_apply: Use the Register page on the WYSE site, or have someone submit a nomination (wsp.gmu.edu/nominate). Call 703-993-5010 for cost and deadlines.
